decisions.reason: A black-finish variant of existing ranges costs little to keep in the catalogue and preserves an option on the design trend while demand is still uncertain.

A shower channel for seamless coverings fits the firm's core barrier-free bathroom strategy, has its own dedicated page and needs more time for its value to resolve, so keeping the option open is cheap.

The pump-assisted solution is a more uncertain niche with only a brief website mention, but one year is too early to judge, and keeping it opens renovation applications where gravity drainage is impossible.
A tileable floor drain is close to the core range, uses existing manufacturing and has a page of its own, so keeping it costs little while its prospects develop.
A stainless steel design grate uses the firm's own metal fabrication and design positioning at low holding cost, and early results give no signal that would justify abandoning it.
